definitions.explanation: Something perceived by the nose. Can be pleasant or unpleasant depending on context.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{匂|にお}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.notes: がする = to perceive a smell

examples.english: I like the smell of this flower.
There's a strange smell, isn't there?

examples.japanese: ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{匂|にお}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦してきました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A nice smell of cooking came from the kitchen.
I really like the smell of earth after rain, so when the rain stops I want to go outside.

notes:
{匂|にお}い refers to smells perceived by the nose, and can describe both pleasant and unpleasant odors.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {匂|にお}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to smell (of something), to have a smell
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{匂|にお}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to smell good
- ⟦{変|へん}な→変：01124_hen⟧{匂|にお}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to smell strange
- {匂|にお}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嗅|か}ぐ→嗅ぐ：02036_kagu⟧: to smell (actively sniff)
- {匂|にお}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くる→来る：00254_kuru⟧: a smell comes wafting over

WRITING:
- {匂|にお}い: neutral, can be good or bad
- {臭|にお}い: often implies a bad smell

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: fragrance, pleasant scent (flowers, perfume)
- ⟦{臭|くさ}さ→臭い：01133_kusai⟧: stench, foul odor (always negative)
- ⟦{香|こう}→香：17307_kou⟧: incense; fragrance (literary)

RELATED VERB:
- ⟦{匂|にお}う→匂う：00319_niou⟧: to smell, to give off a scent
